card.text: ε Eridani b, found by radial velocity in 2000, orbits its star every 7.33 years.

sources.label: Thompson et al. 2025

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Epsilon Eridani b"
sources.quote: Epsilon Eridani b, formally named AEgir [sic], is an exoplanet approximately 10.5 light-years away orbiting the star Epsilon Eridani, in the constellation of Eridanus.

introduction.text: ε Eridani b was found by radial velocity. Thompson et al. (2025) measured the size, tilt and orientation of its orbit from its star's motion.

sources.label: Thompson et al. 2025
sources.locator: Thompson et al. (2025), AJ 170, 301, Table 3 (RV, HIP, FGS, DR2, DR3): P 7.33 yr, a 3.53 au, i 40 degrees, node 186 degrees, mass 1.00 Jupiter masses; NASA Exoplanet Archive pscomppars calculated pl_radj 1.23

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Epsilon Eridani b"
sources.quote: The planet was discovered in 2000, and as of 2025 remains the only confirmed planet in its planetary system.

shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
